title: Annual Dance Fest
description: An electrifying evening of dance performances by student groups from across the university. From classical to contemporary, the Annual Dance Fest celebrates creativity and culture. Doors open at 15:30.

title: Contemporary Dance Workshop
description: A hands-on session exploring contemporary dance forms led by guest choreographers. Open to all skill levels. Wear comfortable clothes.

title: Open Mic Evening
description: Take the stage or enjoy the acts. Singers, poets, comedians, and storytellers welcome. Performances run 3–5 minutes each. Sign up at the door or register online.

title: Battle of Bands
description: Six student bands compete for the campus title. An evening of original music, rock, fusion, and everything in between. Free entry for registered students.

title: 24-Hour Hackathon
description: Build something amazing in 24 hours. Solo or in teams of up to four, tackle real-world challenges with mentors and resources provided. Cash prizes for the top three teams.

title: E-Sports Night
description: Competitive gaming across multiple titles including VALORANT, FIFA, and Chess. This event has been cancelled. Check back for the rescheduled date.

title: Inter-Faculty Football Cup
description: The annual Inter-Faculty Football Cup returns with all departments competing for the championship title. Come cheer for your faculty and witness the best student football on campus.

title: Intro to Maker Tools
description: Get hands-on with 3D printers, laser cutters, and microcontrollers. A beginner-friendly session run by Beyonder Studios. No prior experience required.

title: AI Ethics and Society
description: A conversation with industry researchers on AI ethics, bias in models, and responsible deployment. Open Q&A after the talk.

title: Campus Career Fair 2026
description: Meet 30+ recruiters from tech, consulting, and research. Bring your resume. Internship offers and PPOs on the spot for shortlisted candidates.

title: Student Film Screening
description: An evening of short films made by Atria students over the past year. Followed by a panel Q&A with the directors. Popcorn provided.

title: Autumn Literature Circle
description: A reading and discussion session on contemporary Indian fiction. This month's pick is announced on the club board. New members welcome.

title: Robotics Project Expo
description: Teams present their semester robotics projects to faculty judges and peers. Best project wins a lab budget grant for next semester. Walk-ins welcome for spectators.

title: Spring Hackathon 2026
description: The spring edition of the campus hackathon. This event has already taken place.
